name: get_repair_quote
description: Get a fair repair price for a broken household item, the price of buying new, the best nearby karigars and the next pickup times. Call this before booking.
pre_call_message: एक मिनट, मैं दाम देख रही हूँ।

description.description: What is broken, in the caller's words, e.g. 'mixer jar ka blade dheela hai'

category.description: One of: shoes, bags, clothes, small-appliance, electronics, furniture, plumbing, electrical. Leave empty if unsure.

name: book_repair
description: Book the repair after the caller agrees to the price. Needs quote_id and karigar_id from get_repair_quote, the caller's name and address, the chosen pickup slot_index, and who pays. If a family member pays, also their 10-digit mobile number: the PayPal link is texted to it.
pre_call_message: ठीक है, मैं बुकिंग कर रही हूँ।

address.description: Full pickup address with a landmark

karigar_id.description: karigar_id the caller chose (default: the first one)

slot_index.description: slot_index of the chosen pickup time from get_repair_quote

payer_name.description: Who will pay with PayPal (e.g. 'Rahul'). Empty if the caller pays.

payer_relation.description: Payer's relation, e.g. 'son', 'daughter'. Empty if the caller pays.

payer_phone.description: 10-digit mobile number of the family member who pays. Empty if the caller pays (the link then goes to the caller's own number).

name: get_repair_status
description: Tell the caller where their repairs are (picked up, with the karigar, out for delivery...) and the status of any open warranty claim, including a question the Sudhaar team asked them.

name: cancel_booking
description: Cancel a booking that hasn't been picked up yet. Confirm with the caller first.

order_id.description: Order number if the caller said it, else empty

name: raise_warranty_claim
description: File a warranty claim in Resolve Hub when a repaired item has a problem again. If the repair already has an open claim, the caller's words are added to it.
pre_call_message: मैं आपकी शिकायत दर्ज कर रही हूँ।

order_id.description: Order number if known, else empty

issue.description: One of: repair_failed, damaged, overcharged, delayed, missing

details.description: What went wrong, in the caller's words

name: send_otp_sms
description: The caller can't find their pickup or delivery OTP. Texts it to the mobile number registered on the order (never read it out on the call).
pre_call_message: मैं OTP आपके नंबर पर SMS कर रही हूँ।

order_id.description: Order number if known, else empty

name: request_callback
description: The caller wants to talk to a person, is upset, or needs something you can't do (change a pickup time, resend a pay link). Files a callback request for the Sudhaar team and texts the caller that someone will call.
pre_call_message: ठीक है, मैं टीम को बता रही हूँ।

reason.description: One line: what they need, in English

order_id.description: Order number if known, else empty
